turns.question: By how many euros did our average order grow from August to September 2026?
turns.answer: Average order value (EUR) was 92.25 EUR in August 2026 and 114.39 EUR in September 2026 (full calendar months, non-cancelled orders), so the rise is the difference between those two figures. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
